description.en: Yutyrannus huali: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1.0m whole length ART SETTING; adult holotype ZCDM V5000 anchor, Xu2012. Pose, muted gray-brown/lighter underside, lips, crest contours, exact ratios and tuft density are artistic. Distributed filament fossil patches support inferred broad coat, not preserved exact feather length or colour. Deep skull, low nasal ridge, substantial three-finger arms; no flight feathers, no raptor sickle toe. Not a scientific life reconstruction claim.
